decision.explanation: The question asks for the construction date of the Howard County Courthouse. Multiple documents provide conflicting dates for different Howard County Courthouses across various states. Document D1S1 and D2S5 both mention the Howard County Courthouse in Iowa being built in 1880. Document D4S2 refers to a third courthouse in Howard County (likely Iowa) being built in 1906. Document D5S1 claims the courthouse in Cresco, Iowa was built in 1920. Document D7S4 mentions the Howard County Courthouse in Nebraska was built in 1912. Since these refer to different Howard County Courthouses in different states, each date is valid for its respective courthouse and location.
